prompt.alinti: You can now vibe code an entire app without your company's data ever leaving its own cloud. You basically describe the internal tool or the customer portal or the workflow that you want, and Superblocks builds it with AI. But if you already built it in Claude, then you can connect the Superblocks MCP and bring that app straight in to Superblocks. So whether you built it with Superblocks or with Claude, your app can now run in your own cloud with your company's security on it, so your sensitive data stays inside your own infrastructure.

The way that it actually builds is really smart. Most AI builders hand the whole build to one giant agent, but Superblocks splits it across specialized agents. It uses frontier models for the difficult reasoning, and then it hands build work to cheaper open source models running in parallel.

Then, before anything actually ships, security agents check for things like auth bypasses, business logic flaws, and supply chain vulnerabilities, and your existing SSO, permissions, and audit rules can apply automatically across the apps that people are building.

So instead of having to choose between banning Vibe Coding completely or letting everyone build whatever they want with company data, you get a third option. People can build with AI while IT and security still keeps control.
